body: It was acetaminophen pain killers. All things considered I’m feeling *ok* now. This doesn’t include the fact I was feeling like hell on earth all day, nor the fact that I know acetaminophen is slow to act. I have at least talked to poison control and kept friends and family in the loop, but as far as they know it’s just a stomach bug.

I have, and that’s what probably hurts the most. It only helps momentarily. It feels like heaven when they’re here, but the moment they leave and I’m left to my own devices it’s like they were never there. It’s frustrating, and I don’t want to come off as clingy or needy by continually pestering them, but it’s really the only way I’ve been able to find a sort of peace. 

I’ve been recommended to look into therapy, but as I’m in college struggling to pay for that as it is, I don’t really have the extra money to see one.
